name: somatosim_spike_snv
summary: Given a small analysis-ready BAM plus a BED of target regions, spike in 100 somatic SNVs at a target variant allele fraction (0.01–0.05) and emit a modified, indexed BAM plus a results table whose observed VAFs match the requested range.

name: reditools2_serial_dnarna
summary: Given an RNA-Seq BAM aligned to hg19 chr21 plus the chr21 reference FASTA, produce a per-position RNA-editing table (REDItools DnaRna output) listing covered positions, base counts, and detected substitutions including A-to-G (A-to-I) editing candidates.

name: spheroscan_predict
summary: Given a single spheroid microscope image, segment the spheroid with the pretrained Detectron2 Mask R-CNN and output a spheroidArea.csv row containing its area (in pixels), intensity, and circularity.

name: hots_dti_binding
summary: Given a drug SMILES and a protein amino-acid sequence, load the shipped pretrained HoTS weights and predict (a) the drug-target interaction probability and (b) binding regions on the protein sequence.

name: aizynthfinder_retrosynthesis
summary: Given a single target molecule as a SMILES string, produce a retrosynthetic route breaking it down into purchasable/in-stock precursors via MCTS guided by the pretrained USPTO expansion-policy network.

name: ensemblesplice_donor_hs3d_bal
summary: Given a fixed-length DNA sequence window (a candidate GT donor or AG acceptor site), classify it as a true vs. false splice site using the pretrained EnsembleSplice ensemble (4 CNNs + 4 DNNs), and reproduce the ensemble's donor test accuracy on the shipped HS3D balanced test set.

name: sodar_samplesheets_isatab_import
summary: Import a fresh ISA-Tab investigation (i_/s_/a_ files) via SODAR's Samplesheets app and materialize it into modeled study/assay sample-sheet objects (sources, samples, materials, processes).

name: annotate_my_genomes
summary: Take a StringTie transcriptome assembly GTF (chicken galGal6 chromosome 33) plus the galGal6 reference genome and produce an annotated GTF that classifies transcripts as known vs novel and emits transcript, CDS, and predicted protein FASTA files.

name: prodigy_cryst
summary: Given a single protein-protein complex PDB file, classify its interface as biological (BIO) or crystallographic (XTAL) with probabilities, using the shipped pretrained scikit-learn contacts-based classifier.

name: lilikoi_disease_classification
summary: Given the shipped plasma breast-cancer metabolite table, run the full lilikoi pipeline (metabolite->pathway mapping, per-sample Pathway Deregulation Scores, mutual-information pathway selection, and 7-algorithm classifier training) to produce a Cancer-vs-Normal classifier and its held-out ROC AUC.

name: mirge_annotate_human
summary: Given a small-RNA-seq FASTQ, run miRge2.0 'annotate' with the human library and emit miR.Counts.csv quantifying which annotated miRBase miRNAs each read maps to.

name: meirlop_motif_enrichment
summary: Given the shipped DNase-hypersensitive-site scored FASTA (notebooks/scored_fasta.fa) plus JASPAR motif matrices, run MEIRLOP's logistic-regression motif-enrichment inference and reproduce that CTCF (MA0139.1) is a top significantly-enriched TF binding motif.

name: blmrm_ase_detection
summary: Given the shipped bovine RNA-seq allelic-count table (genes × SNPs × replicates), run BLMRM's two-step inference (para.est then detection) to output the genome-wide list of genes called as allele-specific-expression (ASE) at FDR 0.05, with per-gene posterior probabilities.

name: phenoexam_hpo_enrich
summary: Given a small set of human gene symbols, run PhenoExam::PhenoEnrichGenes and return a table of statistically enriched phenotype terms (with hypergeometric Bonferroni/FDR p-values) from the HPO database.

name: nitpicker_findpath
summary: Given a handful of example time-course curves, select the best subset of N time points to sample in a follow-up experiment (findPath returns the indices of the chosen time points).

name: imputeqc_fastphase_qc
summary: Given a small genotype panel, hide 10% of genotypes, impute them with fastPHASE, and report the imputation discordance (proportion of wrongly imputed genotypes) that imputeqc uses to select the optimal number of haplotype clusters K.
notes: re-verified True (two-list verifier): discordance=0.0176 <= 0.1; was false-negative runs-unverified

name: ehdprep_semantic_enrichment
summary: Given the shipped synthetic health dataset plus its ontology and variable-to-ontology mapping, run eHDPrep's semantic_enrichment() to generate new ontology-derived meta-variables (columns named 'MV_[label]_[function]') that were not in the input table.

name: drugtax_taxonomy
summary: Given a small-molecule SMILES string, produce its DrugTax chemical taxonomy (kingdom + superclass assignments) and the 163-element explainable feature dictionary.

notes: scout failed: Claude Code returned an error result: success

name: eccsplorer_mapping
summary: Given the shipped paired-end amplified-circular-DNA reads plus genomic control reads and a sugar-beet reference genome, run ECCsplorer's mapping module to detect extrachromosomal circular DNA (eccDNA) candidate regions (per-candidate FASTA + enrichment/coverage summary + BLAST annotation).

name: gadma_yri_ceu_inference
summary: Given the 2-population YRI_CEU joint allele-frequency spectrum, infer a demographic history (population sizes, split time, and migration rates) and report the best-fit model's composite log-likelihood.
notes: verification inconclusive: log_likelihood direction not auto-nameable; value -1131.46 clears the -1200 floor (genuine revival)

name: tampa_profile_viz
summary: Given a CAMI-format predicted taxonomic profile plus a ground-truth profile, render an annotated taxonomic-tree visualization comparing the two at a chosen rank (e.g. class).
notes: independent smoke ERRORS (FileNotFoundError: output PNG not produced) — genuine, not a direction artifact; NOT upgraded

name: metroid_bss_denoise
summary: Given a low-SNR single-cell fluorescence membrane-potential video (a shipped .tif stack) plus its cell mask and frame rate, run the METROID blind-source-separation pipeline to recover a denoised transmembrane-potential signal trace separated from noise.

Given the shipped METABRIC breast-cancer example (expression + CNA + clinical for 31 identified driver genes), run DrGA's DriverGeneAnalysis end-to-end and produce its driver-gene analysis outputs — per-gene survival associations, WGCNA functional modules, and enrichment results.
